## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-7phj-vgxq-r67h. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description
Concurrent execution using shared resource with improper synchronization ('race condition') in ASP.NET Core allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
Advisory.Summary: Duplicate Advisory: Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-114157 - ASP.NET Core Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
